blurb: Fishing Western and Eastern Long Island Sound targeting Striped Bass, Bluefish, False Albacore, Atlantic Bonito inshore, and Bluefin and Yellowfin Tuna offshore. Specializes in Light Tackle, Fly Fishing, Topwater, and Sight-fishing using lures and flies. Operates two boats: a 20' Seacraft and a 26' Regulator.
